question: Where should the kalā Ṛddhi be placed with the mantra sadyojātāya namaḥ?
premises: The kalā to be placed is Ṛddhi.
The specified location is the sole of the right foot.
inference: One should place Ṛddhi on the sole of the right foot with sadyojātāya namaḥ.
uncertainties: The element udak is interpreted as indicating the right side in this context.
plain_english: With ‘sadyojātāya namaḥ’, one should place Ṛddhi on the sole of the right foot.
